S4-01.note: Signed (Ed25519, operator TrustStore) claims in a hash-chained SQLite event log; replay rebuilds state; survives restart. Single host SQLite; keys are test keys; no key rotation workflow (S0-03 blocked).

S4-02.note: Claim signature covers a binding with exactly agent/runtime/policy/tool/witness/artifact/issuer/verifier; binding values are the dependency digests, so a change suspends the claim. Values are opaque strings supplied by the caller; nothing verifies they match a real artifact.

S4-03.note: Closed reason set (adapter/tool/agent change, consent revoked, journal lost, proof expired, policy changed, witness unhealthy, operator revoked) plus digest change, expiry and epoch; each tested to suspend. Detection of the real-world change is NOT implemented: callers must report it.

S4-04.note: ProtectedFileWriter(gate=...) denies at commit time, fail-closed on error; a denied effect burns its permit (verifier consumes the nonce first). Wired for the file sink only, not HTTP/process effects or the MCP path.

S4-05.note: 4 worker processes race a revoke: no PERMIT logged after REVOKE and returned-True count equals logged PERMITs; 3 SIGKILL rounds leave a valid chain. One host, SQLite locking; no network partition or multi-host test.

S4-06.note: Append-only log: invalidation/restoration/revocation are new events, PERMITs and failed claims stay in history; mid-log edits/deletes fail closed. LIMIT (tested): tail truncation passes the chain check; only an external anchor (head/check_anchor) catches it, and no independent anchor exists yet.

S4-07.note: Grade is SOURCE_VERIFIED unless an attestation signed by a DIFFERENT key under the reproducer/auditor role issuer verifies; self-attest, wrong role, wrong claim and unknown keys are ignored. No real independent reproducer exists, so no claim is above SOURCE_VERIFIED in practice.

S4-08.note: Finite indistinguishability certificate with independent re-verification and missing-witness suggestion; toy worlds authored by the same author.
